You will fight to keep religion out of government-including through challenges to religious coercion in public schools, religious proselytization by governmental officials, and public funding of religious institutions. And your work will include defending the rights of women, LGBTQ+ people, and racial and religious minorities against religion-based discrimination and oppression.
About Americans United. Americans United is a nonpartisan educational and advocacy organization dedicated to advancing the constitutional principle of church-state separation as the only way to ensure freedom of religion, including the right to believe or not believe, for all of us. Founded in 1947, Americans United is a diverse and dynamic organization composed of people from all walks of life: lawyers and lobbyists, students and activists, religious leaders and impassioned Americans. Americans United includes people of faith and people who don’t profess any particular faith.
For nearly 80 years, we have litigated church-state issues in federal and state courts across the country, with a substantial practice before the federal courts of appeals and the U.S. Supreme Court. Most of our cases involve novel, cutting-edge First Amendment and other constitutional issues. In recent years, for example, we have litigated lawsuits and submitted amicus briefs challenging or opposing:

• Coercive religious practices in the public schools.

• Proselytizing by Trump-Vance Administration officials.

• Public funding of religious education.

• Religion-based refusals by businesses, foster-care agencies, and government officials to provide services to LGBTQ+ people and religious minorities. 

• Religion-based efforts to deprive people of access to abortion and contraceptives.

title: Senior SRE / DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes / A2P Messaging)
description:
This environment will suit you if you enjoy building infrastructure from the ground up, solving hard reliability problems and staying close to the systems you operate in production.
You’ll build and operate the infrastructure behind a new high-volume messaging platform, taking ownership from the Kubernetes cluster and networking layer through observability, deployment and incident response.
The platform processes around 1 million messages every day, supports approximately 175 customers and 120 suppliers, and maintains more than 300 long-lived messaging connections.
This is not a typical stateless web environment. The platform runs long-lived TCP sessions that need stable network endpoints and predictable behaviour during deployments, failures and traffic spikes.
You’ll help build the platform across two infrastructure sites and stay with it through production readiness, migration, hypercare and steady-state operation.
Rate: 150-190 PLN + VAT (B2B) per hour.
Location: Fully remote (Poland) 🌎 or Łódź (Poland)
Your everyday challenges:

• Use AI-assisted engineering where it improves delivery - including infrastructure tooling, automation, documentation and runbooks .

• Build and operate Kubernetes infrastructure across two sites using infrastructure-as-code and automated delivery.

• Design deployment mechanisms that allow long-lived connections to drain gracefully instead of being dropped during releases.

• Take ownership of platform networking , including stable ingress and egress IPs, Layer 4 load balancing, TLS and connectivity coordinated with an external infrastructure provider.

• Build and operate the observability stack : metrics, logs, dashboards and alerting that provide useful signal rather than noise.

• Design monitoring around real production behaviour , including visibility into individual connections and failure modes.

• Own certificate lifecycle, secrets management and platform access control.

• Operate PostgreSQL in a highly available environment, including replication, failover, backups and verified restores.

• Design and exercise backup and disaster-recovery procedures across two sites.

• Work closely with engineers and QA on performance and production-scale load testing, investigating what fails first and why.

• Support the platform during migration and production cutovers.

• Take part in production incident response and from the steady-state phase, a 24×7 on-call rotation.

What are we looking for?

• Experience with telecom, carrier, messaging or other environments built around persistent network connections.

• Knowledge of SMPP, SIP, SS7 or similar telecom protocols.

• Strong production experience operating Kubernetes on self-managed, on-premise or similarly infrastructure-heavy environments - not only managed cloud services.

• Experience with stateful, long-lived TCP workloads on Kubernetes , including connection draining, stable ingress/egress, Layer 4 load balancing and deployment behaviour.

• Strong Linux and networking fundamentals . You are comfortable diagnosing problems involving routing, NAT, firewalls, MTU, TLS or packet-level behaviour.

• Practical troubleshooting experience with tools such as tcpdump and production network diagnostics.

• Experience designing monitoring and alerting , not only maintaining dashboards somebody else created. You understand what deserves to wake a human up, and what does not.

• Strong infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD experience for containerised systems.

• Practical PostgreSQL operations experience, including replication, failover, backup and importantly - verified restore.

• Ability to work directly with engineers from external infrastructure and network providers.

• Professional English.

• Real production on-call and incident-response experience.

What will strengthen your candidacy?

• Experience configuring or troubleshooting IPsec connectivity with external parties.

• Experience designing or operating multi-site active-active or active-pa

title: Territory Partner (Field Sales)
description:
THE ROLE

Omada AI is the AI marketing platform built for small businesses - and we grow the old-fashioned way: in person, face to face, business by business. Territory Partners are the front line of that motion.

This is a true field sales role. You'll walk into local businesses, pitch owners directly, and get them live on Omada the same day. You find your own prospects, build your own pipeline, and close your own deals. There's no cold-call center behind you and no calendar of pre-booked meetings waiting when you log in - the TPs who win here are the ones who don't need one.

If you've done outside sales before and you know the feeling of turning an empty morning into three signed customers by dinner, keep reading.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Prospect your territory relentlessly. Identify, approach, and pitch local SMBs - walk-ins, door pulls, referrals, local networking, whatever works. You own your pipeline end to end.

- Sell in person. Pitch business owners face to face and get them started in a live free trial on the spot - we don't do demos or demo accounts. You build their system on their real business, with their real content, in front of them.

- Run the full sales cycle. From first conversation through trial activation to paid conversion, the deal is yours.

- Master the product fast. Omada is straightforward to learn and pitch - most reps are confidently selling within their first day or two. The hard part isn't the product; it's the hustle. That's why we hire for the hustle.

- Report and improve daily. Track your activity, present your accounts in team reviews, and sharpen your close rate week over week.

HOW WE SET YOU UP TO WIN

- Two-week apprenticeship. You start paired with a veteran Territory Partner: shadow their pitches, then prospect together, then close your own deals with their help (with commission split during the ramp). No classroom fluff - you learn this job by doing this job next to someone who's great at it.

- Proving Ground. Our performance-gated ramp structure rewards producers quickly. Hit your numbers and your earnings and territory opportunities grow with you.

- A real career ladder. TP → Vanguard → City Captain → State Director → Regional Director → Country Manager. We promote from the field, full stop.

- A product that sells. SMB owners need marketing help, most can't afford an agency, and Omada does the work of one for a fraction of the price. When you get in front of the right owner, this sells.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

- Proven field / outside sales experience - you've sold face to face before (D2D, B2B field, territory sales, retail energy/telecom/payments, or similar) and you have the numbers to show for it

- Demonstrated self-prospecting ability - you've built your own pipeline from zero and you're comfortable walking into a business cold

- Closer's mentality - you ask for the business, handle objections in the moment, and don't leave without a next step

- Self-managed and disciplined - you run your day like a business owner, because as a 1099 contractor, you are one

- Reliable transportation and the ability to work your territory in person daily

You'll thrive here if:

- You'd rather be paid for what you produce than for showing up

- You like small business owners and can talk to a plumber, a salon owner, and a realtor in the same afternoon

- You're energized (not intimidated) by rejection volume

- You want a shot at building and leading a market, not just working one

This is not for you if:

- You're looking for a role where meetings are booked for you

- You need warm leads handed over to get going

- You've only sold over the phone or by email and aren't sure about face-to-face

COMPENSATION

Commission-based with performance-gated ramp compensation through our Proving Ground structure. Top producers earn well above typical field sales roles - your income is a direct function of your production. Full details shared during the interview process.
